# The programs that give the fork's refusals a gate row, mostly one for each refusal template that no other program of the gate
# reaches (testdata/gate/fork_refusals.json). A line `=== <template> => <expected>` opens a program, in the fork's grammar, that the
# fork refuses with that message; `<expected>` is the code the new checker refuses it with, or `open` or `retired` where it takes
# it (testdata/gate/open.json, retired.json). build/teal_refusals_test.tl holds each to its template while the fork lives,
# `bin/cosmic build/gate_record.tl --fork` puts them in the verdict table, and lang/check_verdicts_test.tl holds the table to
# the expectation, so that a program the new checker refuses for a reason that is not the rule cannot stand for it.

local x = 1__0
=== invalid token '%s' => stray_byte
local x = $
=== malformed number => malformed_number
local x = 1e
=== unfinished long comment => unterminated_long_comment
--[[ never closed

  if true then
    print(1)
end
